notes.title: update notes sep 03
notes.notes:
+ new element: elem_expr
  evaluates expression at pixel, with pixel specific variables
+ new automata group: turmite
+ new brush: bucket
+ new feature: selection
  pixel, rect, circle, bucket selection
  select-all, invert-all, delete, apply-current-brush operators
  drag & drop selection
+ new visualization mode: sequence
  number sequence visualizations, try it out! (try :square, :triangular and :odious with different transform modes)
  currently there are 6 transformations: :spiral, :array, :vertical-zigzag, :diagonal-zigzag, :hilbert-curve and :z-order-curve
  can be marked as selection, which then can be applied with current brush
+ new visualization mode: plot
  plots with basic presets. (this is for me! i can never remember even the basic sin/cos)
  this too can be marked as selection, which then can be applied with current brush
